## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: /dso:sprint reads the migration-class marker from the plan header and does not recompute detection.
- dd-2: For each automated-sweep / manual-verification pair, sprint sets the verification task's depends_on to the sweep task and schedules the sweep in an earlier batch.
- dd-3: For db-class markers, sprint wires the rollback-verification task to depend_on the forward migration task so the forward migration is scheduled earlier.
- dd-4: For feature-flag pairs, sprint wires the flag-removal cleanup task to depend_on the flag-guarded cutover task so the cutover is scheduled earlier.
- dd-5: When no migration-class marker is present in the plan header, standard batch ordering applies unchanged.

## Implementation
Create plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/apply-two-pass-ordering.sh — the substantive logic the RED suite (task-1) drives to GREEN. Per-story, the helper:
- Reads the LAST MIGRATION_CLASS ticket comment (and the LAST FEATURE_FLAGS comment if present) via the ticket CLI, using the hyphenated key `migration-class` per migration-class-marker.md. READS the persisted marker; NEVER recomputes ast-grep detection (dd-1) — do NOT shell out to any ast-grep / migration-class-detect helper.
- Enumerates the story's child tasks; for each reserved task-type pair present, wires `ticket link <dependent> <earlier> depends_on` IDEMPOTENTLY (check existing depends_on; skip if already present — handles emitter siblings 1c2b/ef21/c5fa already setting it): manual-verification depends_on automated-sweep (dd-2); rollback-verification depends_on the forward migration for db markers (dd-3); flag-cleanup depends_on flag-cutover ONLY when a feature-flag pair exists (dd-4) — NEVER block on FEATURE_FLAGS absence.
- No MIGRATION_CLASS marker (or inconclusive) AND no FEATURE_FLAGS pair → emit NO_MARKER status, write no edges → standard ordering unchanged (dd-5).
Does NOT modify ticket-next-batch.sh (it already defers tasks with open depends_on to a later batch, achieving "schedule earlier" for free once the edge exists). chmod +x.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Helper file exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/apply-two-pass-ordering.sh
- [ ] Behavioral suite passes against the helper
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/skills/sprint/tests/test-migration-pair-order.sh 2>&1; test $? -eq 0
- [ ] dd-1: helper reads the hyphenated migration-class key (not the underscore form)
  Verify: grep -q 'migration-class' plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/apply-two-pass-ordering.sh && ! grep -q 'migration_class' plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/apply-two-pass-ordering.sh
- [ ] dd-1: helper never recomputes detection (no ast-grep / migration-class-detect invocation)
  Verify: ! grep -Eq 'ast-grep|migration-class-detect|\bsg ' plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/apply-two-pass-ordering.sh
- [ ] Helper does not modify/reference ticket-next-batch.sh
  Verify: ! grep -q 'ticket-next-batch' plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/apply-two-pass-ordering.sh
- [ ] dd-2: sweep pair — helper wires manual-verification depends_on automated-sweep
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/skills/sprint/tests/test-migration-pair-order.sh --case sweep 2>&1; test $? -eq 0
- [ ] dd-3: db pair — helper wires rollback-verification depends_on the forward migration
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/skills/sprint/tests/test-migration-pair-order.sh --case db-rollback 2>&1; test $? -eq 0
- [ ] dd-4: feature-flag pair — helper wires flag-cleanup depends_on flag-cutover (only when pair exists)
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/skills/sprint/tests/test-migration-pair-order.sh --case flag 2>&1; test $? -eq 0
- [ ] dd-5: absent-marker case writes no edges and exits 0
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/skills/sprint/tests/test-migration-pair-order.sh --case absent-marker 2>&1; test $? -eq 0

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: GREEN: apply-two-pass-ordering.sh helper (marker read + idempotent depends_on wiring)
